def _build_preview(
        self,
    ) -> tuple[
        FirewallConfig,
        CompiledFirewall,
        CandidateResult,
        CandidateResult | None,
    ]:
        cfg = load_config()

            _BEFORE_RULES.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
            compiled.ipv4,
            allow_openvpn=True,
        )
        result6: CandidateResult | None = None
        if _BEFORE6_RULES.is_file():
            result6 = build_candidate(
                _BEFORE6_RULES.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),

                allow_openvpn=False,
            )

            raise FirewallPolicyError(
                "IPv6 rule exists but before6.rules is unavailable."

# Changelog

## v2.16.0

- ADD Firewall Manager 0.11.0 přidává pure kompozici centrální Hub cache s host-local `firewall.json`; provenance každého pravidla zůstává zachována a žádný zdroj se nepřepisuje.
- POLICY běžná pravidla používají specificity precedence `host-local -> central host -> central group -> central all`; pořadí uvnitř central scope určuje schema 009 `position`. Existující compiler nadále drží bezpečnostní bloky `VPN BAN/izolace -> hard-source ALLOW -> standard`.
- SAFE nové menu `Náhled efektivní Hub + lokální politiky` sestaví a porovná kandidátní pravidla read-only. Apply stále používá výhradně lokální `firewall.json`; centrální cache nemůže spustit UFW reload ani změnu.

replacements.old: - Module 0.9.1 owns local desired state in `/etc/jb_sys_apps/firewall.json` and may mutate UFW **only through the explicit guarded manual Apply/Enable/Disable workflow in `apply.py`**.
replacements.new: - Module 0.11.0 owns local desired state in `/etc/jb_sys_apps/firewall.json` and may mutate UFW **only through the explicit guarded manual Apply/Enable/Disable workflow in `apply.py`**.

replacements.old: - Local VPN servers and rules belong only to the current host. Hub collectors `firewall_vpn_servers` and `firewall_rules` may publish only `origin=host_local,target_kind=host` when schema >=008; they must never touch central host/group/all rows. Central delivery is separate: schema >=009 `firewall_central_policy` may read applicable `origin=central` all/group/host records and atomically cache them in `firewall_hub_policy.json`, but it must not merge them into user-owned `firewall.json` or call Apply/UFW.

Hub collectors `firewall_vpn_servers` and `firewall_rules` may publish only `origin=host_local,target_kind=host` when schema >=008; they must never touch central host/group/all rows. Central delivery is separate: schema >=009 `firewall_central_policy` may read applicable `origin=central` all/group/host records and atomically cache them in `firewall_hub_policy.json`, but it must not merge them into user-owned `firewall.json` or call Apply/UFW. Pure composition may combine the two sources transiently for preview using specificity order host-local -> central host -> central group -> central all. ID/machine/reference ambiguity must fail closed. Existing compiler safety ordering of OpenVPN BAN/isolation before hard-source ALLOW before standard rules remains authoritative.
